notes: Version 2.3 corrects the status of the gauge-group, continuum and co-metric statements, following the Q6a 2.3 audit. The admissibility constraints restrict the algebraic structure of the fibre but do not select it; the SU(2) structure of the spin-1/2 sector enters through the spinor carrier supplied conditionally by O23, and the summary table lists the SU(2) gauge structure as conditional. No identification of the gauge group SU(3) x SU(2) x U(1) is established: O31 version 2.0 is a withdrawal notice, and the colour-sector paragraph credits O31 and O29 only with what they currently state. The large-q continuum limit is stated as a set of requirements whose realisation is open (Q5a, hypothesis [H-L] of Q5b). No coefficient value of the effective co-metric is established: the value 2 of the su(2) Casimir determines no coefficient (Q10), the uniformity hypothesis [U] is not established, and Q11 leaves A_tau/A_H unconstrained, so diag(-2,2,2,2) is not derived. No Foundation theorem is changed.
